none: PAS NLM-6ACAF7: Roman Coin: probably Copy Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Probably a Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed and draped right. Reverse description: Two soldiers, one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this tiny green coin. Diameter: 12mm, Weight: 1.01gms, die axis: 6
